task: Design a landing page hero for a luxury travel company

candidates.content: Hero with a full-bleed video background, three overlapping gradient panels, five call-to-action buttons, animated confetti, and a bright orange banner reading MEGA SALE across the top.
A single full-width photograph of a quiet coastline, one line of serif copy, generous whitespace, and a single understated 'Explore' link.

judgments.rationale: B feels premium and restrained; A is cluttered and off-brand for luxury.
Restraint and whitespace communicate luxury far better.
The single image and serif type read as high-end.

task: Choose a pricing table layout for a SaaS product

candidates.content: Three plans in equal columns with the recommended plan visually elevated, a clear feature comparison, and consistent spacing.
Three plans crammed into a dense grid with tiny type, no highlighted recommendation, and inconsistent row heights.

judgments.rationale: A has clear hierarchy and an obvious recommended plan.
Clarity and spacing make A far easier to scan.
The elevated recommended plan guides the eye.

task: Pick a logo direction for a fintech startup

candidates.content: A generic blue gradient shield with a checkmark, indistinguishable from dozens of other fintech logos.
A restrained monoline mark forming an abstract upward path, in a single confident ink color.

judgments.rationale: B is more distinctive while still feeling trustworthy.
The shield reads as 'secure' immediately, which fintech buyers expect.
Originality matters; the shield is a cliche.

task: Select a color palette for a meditation app

candidates.content: Muted sage, warm sand, and soft slate — a calm, low-saturation palette.
Neon magenta, electric lime, and vivid cyan — a high-energy, saturated palette.

judgments.rationale: Calm low-saturation tones fit meditation.
The neon palette contradicts the product's purpose.
Soft neutrals reduce arousal, which is the point.

task: Choose an onboarding flow for a note-taking app

candidates.content: A single screen that drops the user straight into an empty note with one gentle inline tip.
A seven-screen carousel of feature tours the user must tap through before writing anything.

judgments.rationale: Getting to value fast beats a long tour.
Restraint; the carousel is friction.
Some users like a guided tour up front.

task: Design a data dashboard for executives

candidates.content: Four headline KPIs at the top, one trend chart, and a short ranked list — nothing else.
Twenty-two charts of every metric on one screen with three legends and a rainbow color scheme.

judgments.rationale: Executives need the few numbers that matter.
B is overwhelming and buries the signal.
Restraint makes it feel authoritative.

task: Choose typography for a long-form editorial site

candidates.content: A readable serif at a comfortable measure with generous line height for body text.
A condensed all-caps display face used for entire paragraphs of body copy.

judgments.rationale: Body text must be readable; all-caps is exhausting.
Clarity wins for long reads.
The condensed face destroys legibility at length.

task: Select an illustration style for a children's education brand

candidates.content: Warm, rounded, hand-drawn characters with a friendly limited palette.
Photorealistic corporate stock imagery of adults in an office.

judgments.rationale: Playful illustration fits kids; stock office imagery does not.
Clear brand fit for a children's audience.
Approachable and age-appropriate.

candidates.content: One high-contrast primary button labeled 'Pay now', with secondary actions as quiet text links.
Three equally loud buttons of the same size and color competing for attention.

judgments.rationale: One clear primary action; hierarchy is obvious.
Competing buttons create decision paralysis.
Primary/secondary distinction is textbook good hierarchy.

task: Choose a portfolio layout for a photographer

candidates.content: A quiet full-bleed grid that lets the photographs speak, with minimal chrome and no captions competing for attention.
Every image wrapped in a thick decorative gold frame with drop shadows, a patterned background, and animated sparkles.

judgments.rationale: The work should be the focus; decoration distracts.
Restraint lets the photos carry the page.
Frames and sparkles cheapen strong photography.
